Default path: one baseline monthly (£1,450–£2,000) and one 6-month PIF (£7,800–£9,600) plus payment plans — then raise every 2–4 clients until revenue dips.

**In this lesson**

- Monthly vs 6-month framing
- Look Back Window
- A few price examples
- Advanced variants (optional)

The Profit Coach model: ~6 clients ≈ £10k/mo, via Get Calls (Campaigns), Win Clients (Conversion), and Coach Clients (Coaching).

**In this lesson**

- 6-clients = £10k/mo model
